capabilities: Organize attachments into configured folders with date, type, or token-based subfolders
Rename pasted or dropped files using date or custom token patterns
Find and purge unlinked attachments with a confirmation modal
Extract text from images and PDFs via OCR providers
Auto-process new and modified files in watch folders with batch and rate-limit handling
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a vault backup or maintenance tool; it manages attachments and extracts text via OCR.
extras: README warns the plugin is AI-generated ('vibe coded') and unreviewed by Obsidian staff; install is documented via the BRAT beta tool only.
problem: Obsidian only offers a basic default-location setting for new attachments and provides no renaming on paste, cleanup of unlinked files, or text extraction from images.
